prompts.medium: Write one short factual sentence describing this single image as the visual state of a video segment. State who or what is visible, the current activity if directly visible, important objects, and scene context. Do not infer intent, unseen events, temporal sequence, or outcomes.
prompts.boundary: Compare the two consecutive visual-state captions at the immediate event/state level. Shared generic context such as police, nighttime, road, vehicle, or body-camera is never sufficient. Assess three required conditions independently: (1) same specific physical setting/viewpoint, (2) same immediate visible activity or interaction, and (3) same event state/phase. Return one compact JSON object only with boolean keys same_specific_setting, same_immediate_activity, same_event_state, plus reason (at most 12 words). Do not output a decision. A later deterministic rule will MERGE only when all three booleans are true; uncertainty must be false.
prompts.coarse: Using only the following ordered child Medium captions, write one concise factual summary of their shared broader activity, state, or phase. Preserve temporal order and do not add unsupported facts. Output one sentence only.
prompts.story: Using only the following ordered timestamped semantic Coarse summaries, produce a concise global video map. Return exactly: (1) a line beginning 'Overall story:' with 1-3 factual sentences; then (2) a line 'High-level storyline:' followed by a numbered ordered list. Do not add facts absent from the summaries.

posture_state_conflict_veto.rule: when both captions explicitly name posture/state tokens and their token sets are disjoint, STOP; shared state prevents this veto

anti_chaining.rule: a third or later Medium may extend a candidate only when it remains coherent with both caption and DINO centroids of the complete current group

semantic_coarse.veto_rationale: the pre-registered 0.85 adjacent-representation diagnostic threshold prevents broad caption themes from crossing a strong existing visual transition

photometric_veto_bypass.rule: bypass the DINO STOP veto when standardized grayscale structure persists and luminance or mean colour changes strongly; caption continuity must still independently MERGE
